payload.claim: The docstring says all four shapes 'open IMPLEMENTING then move past it: REPAIRING, REVIEWING, REPAIRING then REVIEWING then REBUTTING, or SPEC_REVIEW then SPEC_WRITING.' The fourth shape, `shapes["spec_reviewed"]` at line 3085, is `("SPEC_REVIEW", "SPEC_WRITING")` with no `IMPLEMENTING` attempt at all before it (the trailing `IMPLEMENTING` is only appended when `trailing=True`, separately from this base sequence). The docstring misstates what the fourth shape's own code does.
